references.phrase: strict inequality A not equal B
references.context: Two sets have different members and are not equal; coupled to non-strict inclusion.

references.phrase: element of B not in A
references.context: An existential witness to strict inclusion, equivalently nonemptiness of B minus A.

references.disposition: Unlike the ordinary subset relation, A and B cannot be identical under this condition.

review_rationale: Read proper-subset definition with both non-strict inclusion and strict inequality; the extra witness of an element in B outside A is required, not optional.
